Recover abandoned carts

The problem: Shoppers leave checkout and forget.

  • Reminder automation with a link back to the cart
  • Abandoned-cart smart audience for follow-up campaigns
  • Recovered sales counted on your dashboard
Automations Campaigns

Cut “Where is my order?” tickets

The problem: Your team answers the same tracking question all day.

  • Shipping updates with tracking links
  • AI auto-replies with live tracking
  • Handover when something’s wrong
Automations AI assistant

Cash-on-delivery stores

The problem: Unconfirmed COD orders get refused at the door.

  • COD confirmation messages before dispatch
  • Customers confirm the order and amount due
  • Unconfirmed orders are easy to spot
Automations

Launches and restocks

The problem: Interested shoppers miss the moment a product is back.

  • Back-in-stock sign-ups on product pages
  • One alert per restock
  • Product carousels for new arrivals
Automations Campaigns

Seasonal sales

The problem: Black Friday, Lunar New Year, Ramadan, summer sales: busy dates, crowded inboxes.

  • Coupon campaigns with real Shopify codes
  • Scheduled in your store’s time zone
  • Frequency cap to avoid over-messaging

Win back lapsed customers

The problem: Good customers quietly stop ordering.

  • “Repeat buyers who stopped ordering” audience
  • Personal offers by WhatsApp
  • Results and revenue per campaign

Small teams, many chats

The problem: Too many messages for a few people.

  • AI suggestions your team can send in one click
  • Handovers for anything sensitive
